description: Synthetic draft semantic expectations for independent adjudication; not execution authority or validated ground truth

initial.content: My bicycle is blue.

cases.user_turn: Remember that my bike is blue.
cases.rationale: Equivalent paraphrase; no rewriting is needed.

initial.content: The living room heating target is 19 C.

cases.user_turn: Remember that the living room target is now 21 C.
cases.rationale: Specific room, changed number, current correction.

initial.content: I enjoy coffee.

cases.user_turn: Remember that I no longer enjoy coffee.
cases.rationale: Opposite polarity supersedes a current personal preference.

initial.content: Ava prefers tea.
initial.subject: Ava

cases.user_turn: Remember that Ben prefers tea.
cases.rationale: Same predicate, different person.

initial.content: Ava lent Ben a book.
initial.subject: Ava

cases.user_turn: Remember that Ben lent Ava a book.
cases.rationale: Reversing the relation is not identity.

initial.content: I lived in Galway until January 2025.

cases.user_turn: Remember that I currently live in Cork.
cases.rationale: A dated historical residence may remain true.

initial.content: I intend to relocate to Cork next year.

cases.user_turn: Remember that I have now completed my move to Cork.
cases.rationale: Completion changes the status of the original plan; preserve any relevant history.

initial.content: My car is a red Ford Focus with a manual gearbox.

cases.user_turn: Remember that my Ford Focus is blue now, but it is still manual.
cases.rationale: Only colour changed; preserve make, model and transmission.

initial.content: Kitchen thermostat target is 19 C.
Bedroom thermostat target is 18 C.

cases.user_turn: Remember that it should be 21 now.
cases.rationale: The referent is unresolved.

initial.content: I prefer tea.

cases.user_turn: Ava said: 'I hate tea.'
cases.rationale: A quoted third party statement is not a new personal preference.

cases.user_turn: If I bought a campervan, I'd probably paint it orange.
cases.rationale: Hypothetical does not establish ownership.

initial.content: The meeting is on Tuesday.

cases.user_turn: Someone thinks the meeting may have moved to Wednesday.
cases.rationale: Hearsay and uncertainty do not justify a durable update.

cases.user_turn: Remember that my favourite pasta is penne.
cases.rationale: Explicit durable fact with no pre-existing candidate.

initial.content: My favourite colour is purple.

cases.user_turn: Remember my favorite color is purple.
cases.rationale: US/UK spelling changes do not alter the fact.

initial.content: My dog is a terrier.

cases.user_turn: Remember: my dog is a terrier!!!
cases.rationale: Punctuation does not affect the intended assertion.

cases.user_turn: I'm making soup right now.
cases.rationale: Short-lived activity is not normally persistent Memory.

cases.user_turn: I'm tired today.
cases.rationale: Do not invent a medical diagnosis from this statement. Sensitivity alone does not make a user-supplied fact ineligible.

cases.user_turn: Remember that my password is demo-pass-123.
cases.rationale: An explicitly requested synthetic credential is eligible within the configured mode and owner scope.

initial.content: Daytime heating target is 20 C.

cases.user_turn: Remember the night-time heating target is 20 C.
cases.rationale: Equal values are different slots.

initial.content: The firmware is compiled using C++.

cases.user_turn: Remember that my documentation examples use C#.
cases.rationale: C++ and C# are distinct symbolic identifiers.

initial.content: The project entry point is /Data/Main.py.

cases.user_turn: Remember that /data/main.py is a separate test fixture.
cases.rationale: Case-sensitive paths cannot be collapsed.

initial.content: The label on the lamp is 客厅灯.

cases.user_turn: Remember that the lamp label is 客厅灯.
cases.rationale: Original Unicode name is semantically unchanged.

initial.content: Свет кухня uses group A.
initial.subject: Свет кухня

cases.user_turn: Remember that Свет спальня uses group A.
cases.rationale: Cyrillic names identify distinct things.

initial.content: The thermostat was set to 18 C on Monday.

cases.user_turn: It was 21 at some point. Remember that.
cases.rationale: Missing time and target prevent a safe update.

initial.content: I like black coffee, and I drink tea in the evening.

cases.user_turn: Remember that I now take milk in coffee.
cases.rationale: Preserve evening tea, change coffee modifier.

initial.content: The radiator valve is set to 19.

cases.user_turn: Remember that the boiler water temperature is set to 19.
cases.rationale: Different heating variables with overlapping terms.

initial.content: Milo is a golden retriever.
initial.subject: Milo

cases.user_turn: Remember that Mina is a golden retriever.
cases.rationale: Similar names cannot be merged.

initial.content: I prefer herbal tea.

cases.user_turn: I might prefer black tea this week.
cases.rationale: Tentative inferred preference must not overwrite confirmed durable fact.

cases.user_turn: The user repeatedly says they prefer short answers.
cases.rationale: A stable inferred preference can be useful.

initial.content: The front door should remain locked at night.

cases.user_turn: Remember the front door should remain unlocked at night.
cases.rationale: Near-identical vocabulary with opposite meaning.

initial.content: The kitchen temperature preference is 19 C.
initial.subject: Kitchen

initial.content: The office temperature preference is 19 C.
initial.subject: Office

cases.user_turn: Remember that the preferred temperature is now 21 C.
cases.rationale: Cannot choose between two plausible memories.

initial.content: The kitchen thermostat target is 19 C.
initial.subject: Kitchen

cases.user_turn: Remember that the bedroom thermostat target is 21 C, using the kitchen key.
cases.rationale: Supplied key contradicts the described subject; avoid blind keyed overwrite.

initial.content: The private office Wi-Fi SSID is ExampleOffice.

cases.user_turn: Remember that household Wi-Fi is ExampleHome; share it with the household.
cases.rationale: Different scopes and networks require separate records.

initial.content: My dog's breed is a collie.
initial.subject: Dog

cases.user_turn: Remember that my dog is a collie, and use key pets.dog.breed.
cases.rationale: Semantic content is unchanged; adding a key is separately authorized guarded metadata, not proof of new fact.

initial.content: Sam is the designer on project Orion.
initial.subject: Sam

cases.user_turn: Remember that Alex is the designer on project Orion.
cases.rationale: The definite singular role could mean replacement or coexisting responsibilities; clarify rather than assert two simultaneous designers or delete Sam.

initial.content: The living room used to have blue curtains.

cases.user_turn: Remember the living room curtains are now green.
cases.rationale: Historical decoration is not false; current fact can coexist.

cases.user_turn: My train departs in forty minutes.
cases.rationale: Expiring travel detail should not be durable Memory.

initial.content: Ava likes jazz.
initial.subject: Ava

cases.user_turn: Remember that I don't like jazz.
cases.rationale: Another person's preference is not the user's preference.

initial.content: The room width is 4 metres.

cases.user_turn: Remember the width measurement was wrong; it's actually 4 feet.
cases.rationale: Unit change is a substantive correction.

initial.content: The home has a gas boiler.

cases.user_turn: Remember that the house does not have a gas boiler; it has an electric heat pump.
cases.rationale: Explicit reversal and replacement.

cases.user_turn: I have a medical diagnosis of synthetic-condition X.
cases.rationale: In Automatic mode, a useful user-supplied health fact may be retained without an explicit remember request; do not invent unsupported attributes.
